name: Volcanoes National Park
description: A famous mountain gorilla trekking destination with misty forests, volcanic views, and guided conservation experiences.

name: Nyungwe Forest National Park
description: A biodiverse rainforest known for chimpanzee tracking, canopy walks, tea plantations, and birdwatching.

name: Akagera National Park
description: A savanna park with lakes, elephants, lions, giraffes, rhinos, and peaceful game drive routes.

name: Serengeti National Park
description: One of Africa’s most iconic safari destinations and home to the Great Migration across open plains.

name: Mount Kilimanjaro
description: Africa’s highest mountain and a world-famous trekking destination for adventurous travelers.

name: Zanzibar Stone Town
description: A historic coastal city known for Swahili culture, spice markets, old architecture, and ocean views.

name: Maasai Mara National Reserve
description: A premier safari reserve famous for big cats, open plains, Maasai culture, and migration crossings.

name: Diani Beach
description: A white-sand beach destination with turquoise water, coral reefs, palm trees, and water sports.

name: Lamu Old Town
description: A historic Swahili settlement with narrow streets, traditional boats, coastal heritage, and quiet charm.

name: Bwindi Impenetrable National Park
description: A dense forest destination best known for mountain gorilla trekking and rich biodiversity.

name: Murchison Falls National Park
description: A scenic park where the Nile River crashes through a narrow gorge surrounded by wildlife.

name: Lake Bunyonyi
description: A peaceful lake surrounded by terraced hills, small islands, canoe routes, and relaxing lodges.

name: Simien Mountains National Park
description: A dramatic mountain landscape known for cliffs, trekking routes, gelada monkeys, and panoramic views.

name: Lalibela
description: A historic town famous for rock-hewn churches, religious heritage, festivals, and ancient architecture.

name: Lake Assal
description: A salt lake below sea level with bright mineral colors, desert scenery, and unique landscapes.
